audit.note: re-read the confirmed criteria from the state file's audit: artifact if one was written, otherwise re-run the criteria interview; never assume criteria a previous session did not record

diagnosis.note: bugs only — with devcycle's notes for this stage in commands/cycle.md § Stage walk; read that entry, since this session may never have loaded it

brainstorm.note: with devcycle's notes for this stage in commands/cycle.md § Stage walk; read that entry, since this session may never have loaded it

execution.note: resume each task from its last ledger event, per the per-task table in references/resume.md § Resuming a wave's per-task position

on-device.note: re-walk its human-required checklist walkthrough; a stale state file never counts as having cleared it

receiving-review.note: a standalone reconcile stage, re-entered per §6.6 of its own flow; not part of the pipeline walk

finish.note: it owns the whole stage: gitPolicy resolution, the external-push-signal clamp, acting on the effective policy, the Git policy: handoff line, and the stage: done close
